tests: Seed: WebGL preview changes pixels and exports a non-empty PNG
Seed: Undo and Redo restore and reapply a GPU color change

trigger: After the stale-closure repair made scheduleRender stable and moved render-setting ownership to a ref, the render effect no longer depended on React settings state; user setting transitions updated the ref but did not trigger a new scheduleRender invocation.
propagationPath: control interaction -> commit/undo/redo updates settings and renderSettingsRef -> scheduleRender effect remains unchanged because its dependency list excludes settings -> no RAF is scheduled -> canvas data-render-revision remains 1 -> browser synchronization predicate times out.
violatedInvariant: Every committed render-affecting Seed settings transition must cause exactly one coalesced render request that consumes the latest committed settings ref, while avoiding stale-closure rendering.
responsibleSource: src/tools/seed/index.tsx render scheduling effect dependency ownership
observableSymptom: Chromium FAST shard-2 failed two independent Seed rendering tests with data-render-revision stuck at "1" for 3000ms, while other Seed tests and browsers were not implicated in the same way.

evidence.failure: tests/seed.spec.ts:20 waitForGpuRender timed out expecting render revision != "1" at lines 39 and 74

repairPlan.mechanism: Retain stable scheduleRender reading renderSettingsRef inside RAF, and restore settings as an explicit dependency of the scheduling effect so every committed basic-state transition schedules a coalesced render without capturing settings in the callback.
repairPlan.regression: Keep the existing exact render-revision and exact-pixel assertions. The current run fails before the repair at the contract boundary.

verificationPlan: Certification on the exact resulting main SHA
